notes.title: 🎉 Eternal Hunt is now in Early Access!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]Hello Hunters![/p][p]After a long development journey, [i]Eternal Hunt[/i] is now available in [b]Early Access[/b] on Steam![/p][p]In this spell-based top-down roguelite, you fight through handcrafted stages filled with enemies, unlock new abilities, and grow permanently stronger with each run.
Each session brings new builds and magical combinations.[/p][p]💥 Features:[/p][list][*][p]Spell-based top-down action[/p][/*][*][p]Roguelite progression with permanent upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Unlockable characters and abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Colorful pixel art with a slight dark fantasy tone[/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the beginning! New content, characters, and balancing updates are on the way.
Looking forward to your feedback![/p][p]🎮 Steam page:
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3835010/Eternal_Hunt/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Happy hunting!
– Barış[/p]

notes.title: Eternal Hunt – Coming to Early Access on July 14!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Hunters! 🧙‍♂️[/p][p]After a long development journey, [b]Eternal Hunt[/b] is launching in [b]Early Access on July 14, 2025[/b]!
It’s time to enter the shadows and fight for your survival in a world full of chaos and magic.[/p][h3]🔥 What to Expect[/h3][p]⚔️ [b]Wave-based survival combat[/b] – Fight off endless hordes of enemies, each with unique patterns and behaviors.
🔮 [b]Unique spells and upgrades[/b] – Level up and choose powerful abilities that match your playstyle.
💎 [b]Permanent progression[/b] – Collect gems during each run to unlock permanent upgrades.
🏆 [b]Global leaderboard[/b] – Compete with players worldwide to claim your spot at the top.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠 Why Early Access?[/h3][p]The core gameplay is ready, but we want to shape the future of Eternal Hunt [b]together with you[/b].
With your feedback, we plan to add new enemies, spells, maps, balance updates, and more![/p][hr][/hr][h3]📅 Timeline[/h3][p]✅ Core systems are complete
🟡 Final polish and testing underway
🚀 [b]July 14 – Early Access Launch[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]👉 [b]Add the game to your wishlist[/b], leave a comment, and share your thoughts!
We’re excited to grow this game with our community, and we’re listening closely to your ideas and feedback.[/p][p]Thank you – and let the hunt begin! 🎯
[b]– The Eternal Hunt Dev Team[/b][/p]
